description: Kings Crossing is a well-positioned neighborhood shopping center located at the prominent intersection of Kingwood Drive and West Lake Houston Parkway in the heart of Kingwood, one of Houston's most affluent and established residential communities. This 127,296 square foot center serves as a convenient retail hub for the surrounding high-income neighborhoods, offering a carefully curated mix of essential services and popular destinations. Anchor tenants include Ace Hardware and Pet Supply Plus, providing everyday necessities for local homeowners, while a variety of small shop tenants round out the tenant mix with several popular eateries that have become neighborhood favorites. The center benefits from excellent visibility and accessibility at this major intersection, with ample parking at a ratio of 5.22 spaces per 1,000 square feet. Situated in a well-established residential area with average household incomes exceeding $164,000 within one mile, Kings Crossing continues to serve as a valued community gathering place for Kingwood residents seeking quality retail and dining options close to home.
